purpose: Screenshots for the official app installation guide at /#/install

assetPolicy.source: Unedited real emulator or desktop screenshots; not imported by the app.
assetPolicy.highlighted: Image generation results with red numbered annotations; kept for future editing.
assetPolicy.web: WebP quality 90 copies of generated PNGs, same dimensions, no code-drawn annotations. Only these files are imported by the app.

assets.title: PC에서 연결 코드 만들기
assets.prompt:
Edit this exact screenshot for a Korean PWA setup guide. Preserve the entire screenshot, every existing Korean UI label, all icons, geometry, colors, window borders and proportions. Do not reconstruct or redesign the interface. Do not add a phone/device frame. Only add clean red tutorial annotations. Use red #e52b2b, outlined rounded rectangles with no fill, white digits in small solid red circular badges, and short red arrows from badges to the outlined click targets. Do not cover any UI text.
Annotation 1: outline the existing green "설정" sidebar item at bottom left; place numbered badge "1" just above it in the empty sidebar space, with short arrow to that item.
Annotation 2: outline the existing selected "기기 연결" tab near the top center; place badge "2" immediately above it with arrow to the tab.
Annotation 3: outline the existing green "휴대폰 설정 QR 만들기" button in the lower center-left card; place badge "3" in adjacent empty space with short arrow to that button.
No other changes or added words. Keep all three targets and the full app window visible. Output a single final annotated screenshot suitable for a README.
assets.sourceNote: Actual screenshot. Annotation generated separately with built-in image_gen.
